title: Ailanthus Glandulosa
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of malignant diseases, especially of the throat. It is useful in cases of low-grade fevers, with extreme debility and a tendency to a typhoid state. The patient is dull, confused, and may be semi-conscious. There is a general foulness of all secretions. Dull and confused. Semi-conscious. Anxiety and restlessness. Dull headache, with a sensation of weight. Vertigo. Dark red or mahogany color. Expression of pain and anxiety. Swollen and dark red. Ulcers on the tonsils. Foul-smelling breath. Hawking of bloody mucus. Appetite poor. Nausea and vomiting. Tender and distended. Chronic diarrhoea of foul-smelling stools. Shortness of breath. Cough, with bloody expectoration. Dark red or purple eruptions. Petechiae. Worse from motion and in the morning. Compare: Baptisia; Lachesis; Rhus toxicodendron. First to sixth potency.
